The main takeaway from our work is that

, despite being a very difficult task, unsupervised sentiment analysis is feasible, and that the use of compositional operations, combined with universal dependencies, can be a promising direction in the quest of a universal model.
the combination of unsupervised methods and compositional operations can be a powerful tool to tackle multilingual sentiment analysis, and more generally, other NLP tasks.

, despite the recent advances of supervised methods, unsupervised approaches can be competitive and even outperform their supervised counterparts in cross-domain settings, especially when interpretability of results is a requirement.
